maddeler.e:
افترضوا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَضُوا (iftaraḍū) /if.ta.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# اُفْتُرِضُوا (ufturiḍū) /uf.tu.ri.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# اِفْتَرِضُوا (iftariḍū) /if.ta.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
